route.instructions: Which central technical support specialty is responsible for this commercial vehicle service case? Use `technician_note`, `dtc_codes`, `vehicle`, `recent_repairs` and `collected_evidence`.

criteria.engine: Diesel engine mechanical faults: overheating, oil/coolant loss, knocking, smoke from exhaust, power loss of mechanical origin, injection and turbo.
criteria.transmission: Gearbox, clutch, driveline: slipping, hard or delayed shifting, gear noise, transmission warnings.
criteria.lv_electrical: 12/24V system: batteries, starter motor, alternator, fuses, wiring harness, lighting, no-crank or clicking at start.
criteria.ecu_comm: Control units and CAN bus: U-codes, lost communication, multiple unrelated warnings, dashboard/cluster errors, software.
criteria.hv_battery: Electric vehicle traction battery: state of charge drop, cell imbalance, battery temperature, isolation faults in the pack.
criteria.hv_charging: Electric vehicle charging: charger connection, charge session aborts, onboard charger, charging socket.
criteria.hv_inverter: Electric drive: inverter, traction e-motor, power electronics, loss of propulsion in an electric vehicle.
criteria.brakes: Air brakes, ABS/EBS, brake pressure, compressor, brake noise or reduced braking.
criteria.steering_suspension: Steering, power steering, suspension, air suspension, vibration and pulling.

sufficient.instructions: Does the case already contain enough information to identify the responsible technical specialty without asking the technician for further measurements, photos or tests?

critical.instructions: Does this service case involve an immediate safety risk for people?

criteria.true: Fire, burning smell, loss of braking or steering, high-voltage exposure, or the vehicle must not be driven.
criteria.false: No immediate danger to people; the fault affects availability, performance or comfort only.

priority.instructions: How urgent is this service case for the operator?
criteria: Routine: can be handled at the next planned service
Vehicle works but with reduced performance or comfort
Vehicle partially unusable, trips at risk
Vehicle is stranded or there is a safety risk

has_dtc_scan.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: diagnostic trouble codes read with a scan tool, with freeze-frame data? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_battery_voltage.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: 12/24V battery voltage measured at rest, with ignition on and while cranking? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_connector_photo.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: close-up photo or visual inspection of the related connector and wiring harness? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_can_resistance.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: CAN bus termination resistance measurement? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_hv_isolation.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: high-voltage isolation resistance measurement by certified personnel? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_charging_log.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: charging station or onboard charger session error log? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_fluid_check.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: engine oil and coolant level and condition check? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_trans_log.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: transmission oil temperature and gear shift log? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_brake_pressure.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: air brake system pressure and leak test? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_sound_video.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: sound or video recording of the symptom? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_road_test.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: road test reproducing the fault? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.

has_service_history.instructions: Does the case already contain the actual result of this check: recent maintenance and repair history of the vehicle? Only a mention that it should be done does not count.
